description: Per-vendor commercial disclosure: whether SourcingTools.org, the publisher of SourcingBench, has a referral relationship with the vendor (i.e. may earn a fee when a reader requests a demo through SourcingTools.org). Published so readers can see the correlation between referral relationships and rankings for themselves. Referral status is disclosure metadata, not a scoring input; it is mirrored into each cycle's leaderboard.json as a per-tool referral field so the disclosure travels with the ranking data itself.
